responsibility: Is the master declarative database of Arm CPUs, architectures, FPUs, feature bits, aliases, tuning flags, and option relationships from which generated option and scheduling tables are built. Parsed by parsecpu.awk, it defines the supported -mcpu/-march/-mfpu names, their ISA feature sets, optional extensions and removals, default tuning/cost selections, architectural quirks, and identifying metadata such as vendor and part numbers.
